summary: An earthen vessel is hard and fragile, like the psalmist’s strength.

senses.definition: An earthenware vessel can be broken. The sufferer likens his dried strength to a potsherd. Job takes a shard to scrape his skin.

note: The sin in חֶרֶשׂ distinguishes the pottery word from חֶרֶשׁ with shin. The texts show both a whole vessel and a broken piece.
